items.title: Dominion Energy (D) Stock Shrugs Off Q3 Earnings As Project Risks Linger
items.summary: Dominion Energy stock closed at US$65.12 before the Q3 2026 report and now trades at US$66.62, a 2.3% move that looks modest for such a closely watched utility. Q3 landed with solid power, with basic earnings per share of about US$1.32 on revenue of roughly US$5.6b grabbing attention more than any headline about the share price.
